mapper.select: SELECT tgi.*, tgt.`name` as typeName, u.user_name, u.phone, u.avatar FROM travel_group_info tgi LEFT JOIN travel_group_type tgt ON tgi.type_id = tgt.id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON tgi.user_id = u.user_id where tgi.id = #{id}

SELECT gi.*, gt.`name` as typeName, u.user_name as userName FROM travel_group_user AS gu LEFT JOIN travel_group_info AS gi ON gu.group_info_id = gi.id LEFT JOIN `travel_group_type` gt ON gi.type_id = gt.id LEFT JOIN `tb_user` u ON gi.user_id = u.user_id where gu.user_id = #{param.userId} order by gu.create_time desc
